item.title: Commission approves 149 million euro Swedish State aid for agricultural companies facing increased fuel prices
item.description: The Commission approved under EU State aid rules a Swedish scheme to support companies in the agricultural sector.

item.title: Commission greenlights Belgium fifth payment request under NextGenerationEU
item.description: The Commission endorsed a positive preliminary assessment of Belgium's fifth payment request for 225 million euro under the Recovery and Resilience Facility.

item.title: Eurostat: euro area annual inflation up to 2.4 percent
item.description: Euro area annual inflation was 2.4 percent in July 2026, up from 2.1 percent in June. Housing and energy prices contributed most.

item.title: Commission seeks feedback on proposed amendments to regional State aid guidelines
item.description: The Commission opened a consultation inviting stakeholders to comment on targeted amendments.

item.title: Court of Justice rules national rent caps compatible with EU free movement of capital
item.description: In a judgment delivered today the Court of Justice ruled that national housing rent caps do not breach EU law. The ruling ends a long dispute and is binding on all member states. Landlord associations criticised the decision; tenant campaigners called it historic.

item.title: Statement by Commissioner on the situation in the Western Balkans
item.description: The Commissioner reiterated the European Union's support for the enlargement process and accession negotiations with candidate countries.

item.title: Erasmus+ budget cut by 12 percent in draft MFF, universities warn
item.description: Draft multiannual financial framework figures show the Erasmus+ student mobility programme facing a 12 percent reduction. University associations warned it would price out students from lower-income households. The proposal is contested and MEPs have threatened to reject it.
